challenge.method: Compare the exact 1.10.1 tag tree and compiler option with the version's dialect page and source-file documentation. Check how source can choose another mode and distinguish default interpretation from executable identity.
challenge.results: The release documentation identifies the project's default source dialect and distinct compatibility modes. The accepted spelling is a language identity. The executable, library bundle and other modes retain their own roles.

limitations: The claim is release-scoped documentation of source interpretation. It supplies no universal compiler acceptance or feature guarantee.
